Theresa (People Ops): Quick sync — finalizing the calibration window for next week. Need to lock exception flows and any edge-case rules now, please.
Asha: Two asks from my side: (1) people on parental leave mid-cycle, (2) contractors with <6 months tenure — do we treat them differently in calibration?
Jon (Eng Manager): For contractors I lean toward manager attestation + context note rather than full calibration. Keeps the noise down.
Priya: Agreed on contractors. Also, PIPs should normally be outside calibration unless there's a question about recency/resolution.
Mike_SRE: How do managers submit an exception? Is there a central place or just email people-ops?
Theresa (People Ops): There's a short exception request flow — please submit via the form or paste the template in a ticket. Quick template below (paste into a ticket):
```
Employee: Full name + role
Reason for exception: (e.g., on leave, late joiner, ongoing PIP, parental leave dates)
Dates in scope: (start - end)
Manager attestation: brief justification + impact on rating
Supporting docs: (optional link)
Suggested calibration path: (exclude / limited review / full review)
```
Theresa (People Ops): Link: https://redwood.company/hr/exceptions — form auto-creates a ticket and notifies People Ops.
hr-bot: Exception form submitted — confirmation ID: EX-2026-4187. We'll route this to the calibration queue.
Asha: Nice. Deadlines for exception submissions?
Theresa (People Ops): Key dates: self-assessments due Fri 04/08 11:59pm PST, manager reviews due Fri 04/15 EOD, calibration week Mon 04/22 - Fri 04/26. Exceptions must be submitted by Tue 04/20 5pm PST to be included in pre-calibration materials.
Jon (Eng Manager): If something truly critical pops up after calibration, can we request a retro exception? Not ideal but need a process.
Theresa (People Ops): Retro exceptions are possible but strictly for extenuating circumstances. Manager escalates to VP + People Ops with evidence; we'll triage.
Priya: Also flagging reviewer readiness — we'll run a 30-min calibration rubric refresher on Tue 04/23 09:00 PT. Please mark as required for all managers on the invite.
Theresa (People Ops): Got it — calendar invite going out now. Ping me directly @Theresa for last-minute tweaks or urgent escalations.
Mike_SRE: Thanks — I'll cascade to my managers and share the exception link in team channel :rocket:
Theresa (People Ops): Thanks everyone — filing final process doc and checklist after this thread. I'll include the exception template, deadlines, and escalation matrix.
